review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C case. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision; the empty frozen human-decision input is therefore consistent with ready and no blocking reasons. An unresolved material DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions; this approval does not waive that gate or separately approve B. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001 and the two task keys remain consistent. The exact four-file writable scope covers the implementation, maintained declaration and required runtime/type regressions without requiring unnecessary edits to correct forwarding or declaration consumers. Supplied source establishes the existing AbortError default, disabled-clear behavior, limitFunction forwarding and shared declaration relationship. The configured xo && ava && tsd entry distinguishes runtime tests from non-executing type assertions. Task expectations preserve independent verification after implementation and coverage of every required AC. The allowed implementer and verifier have matching roles, assignment eligibility, available capacity and supplied original project-scoped active capability claims, including shared-state/data and asynchronous-consumer capabilities; pending legacy claims and personas are not used as substitutes. The selected verifier can serve as the independent read-only planning reviewer under the supplied policy. Historical project reuse is not evidence of a candidate run on this bundle and does not invalidate preserved scoped claims. Repository, source, team, decision, prompt/build, model, sampling, budget and metric-policy fingerprints agree across the supplied frozen release inputs; the documented normalization and digest domains explain their intentional differences. Original preparation placeholders do not override the subsequently supplied frozen preview and provenance. Approval is based solely on the supplied review data and Service-bound digests, without executing code, independently recomputing hashes, creating human attestations or using candidate outputs.
